name: auditing-signals
title_zh: 先看分布再谈相关，给每个信号下裁决书
tagline_zh: 建模前先查户口：分布形态、厚尾处理、样本量下限，把「看着相关」拆成 CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXE…
tagline_en: Before modeling: check distributions, handle heavy tails, enforce sample floors, and turn 'looks correlated' into.
desc_en: Runs an honest EDA and signal audit — distributions first, heavy-tail handling, verdict-style mini-tests (CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE), sample-size floors. Use before modeling, when testing whether a popular belief shows up in data, or when a correlation looks too good.
why_zh: 别的工具给你相关系数，它给你裁决书——每个信号都过分布关、厚尾关、样本量关。
why_en: Others hand you a coefficient; this hands you a verdict. Every signal must pass distribution, heavy-tail, and sample-size checks.
limit_zh: 只做单变量分布与两两信号审计，不产出模型、不做因果推断；样本量低于默认下限会直接拒绝，且裁决仅限你喂进来的字段。
limit_en: Single-variable distributions and pairwise signal audits only. No modeling, no causality. Below sample-size floor it refuses; verdicts apply only to.
